reviews.text: An exceptional veterinarian! I have nothing but praise for her.

The veterinarian is a lovely person; she overflows with love for what she does, the way she treats our animals. I left my cat Layca for sterilization knowing she was in good hands; her recovery was perfect!!

Dr. Daniela is just excellent! I (an English-speaker) was visiting Portugal for 3 months as a nomad with my dog. She took care of all Percy’s needs and made sure we had all the paperwork and exams and bureaucracy dealt with to be able to proceed to our next destination, Morocco. She was responsive in communicating, sensible in her recommendations, and always made me and Percy feel well-taken care of. I only wish he were under her care always!
Dr. Daniela is very caring and has a great willingness to deal with our cat Niki's most difficult behaviors! Thank you for your dedication.

Dr. Daniela is extremely caring and highly professional. My dog ​​is afraid of strangers, but with the proper time and respect from her, he can be neutered safely without trauma or unpleasant situations for anyone. It's a relief to know that we have a professional who not only has knowledge of animal health but also knows how to handle animals in the office.
The vet is super attentive, the appointment takes about an hour, and she answers all questions, in addition to investigating various things, not just what the owners report. 10 out of 10!

I have a 2-year-old dog, and he has always been seen by Dr. Daniela since then.
Last Thursday, January 3rd, 2025, he went for his usual deworming treatment. The last time, before January 3rd, he had some vomiting, which seemed normal due to the medication. We had informed the doctor. After January 3rd, 2025, after receiving the last dose of deworming medication, he started vomiting so much that I lost count of how much he vomited. He vomited food, liquid, etc. I spent the night with him vomiting, vomiting, and vomiting. The next morning, my girlfriend and I called the doctor several times and sent messages worried about what had happened. The doctor didn't even respond to the messages, much less the calls. After 2:30 hours, she returned the call rudely, as if we were bothering her with so many calls. I had to rush to another clinic, and there the doctor said that the dose given to my dog ​​was extremely high, even though my dog ​​weighs 6kg and the dose he received was for dogs weighing 10kg. In this whole story, I just want to make it clear that she barely pays attention to the dogs' history, has no predisposition to provide the necessary support after a consultation, and on top of that, I always wait more than 30 minutes for an appointment, which is by appointment only. One thing is certain, my dog ​​almost died! I WILL NEVER RETURN TO THIS veterinary clinic.

WOW 🤩 I went yesterday to book an appointment and it was fully booked but still I immediately got help with the prescription so my dog could get help directly, and then I got an appointment for the day after. Great English, super caring with the animals and explaining how to care for my dog and her wounds 🙌 Can not thank or recommend enough, simply amazing 💚💚

Dr. Daniela is very knowledgeable, caring, understanding and really gives you and your pet her undivided attention when during your visit.  I brought my dog to Portugal from the US and Dr. Daniela helped to make my dog’s transition to Portugal very smooth.
Doctor Daniela is such an angel. I m a first time puppy owner and she is so patient and nice, and very professional when it comes to my puppy! I recommend coming here if you are looking for a vet!
Dr. Daniela is a lovely person. Animals and humans are treated very well by her. By appointment and at affordable prices.
Dr. Daniela is not only an excellent professional, but also very kind and extremely attentive.
Whenever I've been there, my animals have been well treated, but it's difficult to get an appointment for the same day, especially in emergencies. Even so, the doctor is very kind and attentive.
Excellent veterinarian, vast knowledge and affection for all her furry patients.
